title: "Publications"

## Citation policy

MetaLab encourages researchers to use data available on its website. For
example, you can cite meta-analytic results, or download datasets and conduct
custom analyses. Before using MetaLab data in your publication, please cite
the dataset(s) you use (each dataset's citation appears on its page) and the
MetaLab platform papers below.

## Papers about MetaLab

DOI: [10.1111/desc.70028](https://doi.org/10.1111/desc.70028) [[Repository]](https://github.com/anjiecao/metalabr_exp)

**Tsuji, S., Bergmann, C., & Cristia, A. (2014).** Community-augmented meta-analyses: Toward cumulative data assessment. *Perspectives on Psychological Science, 9*(6), 661-665. DOI: [10.1177/1745691614552498](https://doi.org/10.1177/1745691614552498)
